授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 本授業では、東アジアにあるいくつの社会のシティズンシップ教育の政策及び実践を議論して比較する。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This course takes students on an imaginary journey to a number of diverse yet connected Asian societies to critically examine and compare what and how citizenship is taught, i.e. the citizenship education curricula and pedagogies, in and beyond schools. It takes the comparative perspective and focuses on the intentions and implications of citizenship education policies and practices in contemporary Asian contexts.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: citizenship education; policy and practice; Asian societies
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: Although not mandatory, students interested in this course are recommended to first take "Citizenship Education in Contemporary Asia I" in the spring semester of 2026. That course would get you familiar with the theoretical and general issues concerning citizenship and citizenship education in Asia.

授業科目の実施方法について.備考:
There will be reading and other assignments for students to do before class, primarily for the purpose of getting you prepared for in-class discussion. The country/region cases of citizenship education for discussion may be changed depending upon students' interest.
Readings and slides are in English, while the instructor will use both English and Japanese in class. Students are encouraged to use whichever language (English or Japanese) they feel comfortable in class.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.レポート: 50%. Students are required to submit a course essay - in Japanese (2000 words) or in English (1000 words) - in Week 7 to explore the question "Would my citizenship education experience be the same if I were educated in XX?" to reflect and compare individual citizenship education experience with citizenship education in other discussed society than one's own.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.発表: 10%. Students are required to give a presentation in the comparison session in Week 7.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.授業への貢献度: 40%. This course intends to help students develop an understanding of relevant topics on the basis of individual experience. Students are expected to actively engage in in-class activities such as group work and discussion.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.出席: Attendance is the prerequisite for class discussion.
